description:
ChatStore::update_metadata() (chat.rs:511-597) dynamically builds a SQL string with dynamic parameter placeholders and stores values in Vec<Box<dyn rusqlite::types::ToSql>>. This involves a heap allocation per field and a vtable dispatch per parameter bind.

The driver is the 'only update fields that are Some(...)' contract. An alternative that avoids the Vec<Box<dyn>> is to use SQLite's ability to update a column to itself as a no-op: a fixed SQL with COALESCE-style expressions, e.g.:

  UPDATE chats SET
    name = CASE WHEN ?1 THEN ?2 ELSE name END,
    muted = CASE WHEN ?3 THEN ?4 ELSE muted END,
    ...
  WHERE id = ?N

where odd parameters are 'should_update' booleans and even parameters are the new values (or NULL). This yields a single fixed-format prepared statement, cacheable by prepare_cached, with no heap-allocated vtable dispatch. For 8 fields this is 17 parameters vs. up to 9 heap allocations per call.

The tradeoff: the CASE WHEN approach requires all parameters to always be bound even when a field is not being updated. At 8 optional fields this is still simple and fits on one screen.
title: update_metadata builds SQL string with Vec<Box<dyn ToSql>> boxing
